Legal

Disclaimer

The limits of what this site provides: general information, not legal, tax or accounting advice, and no liability for decisions taken on it.

General information only

The material on this site is general information about starting and operating a foreign-invested business in China. It is not legal, tax, accounting, immigration or investment advice, and it is not a substitute for advice from a qualified professional who knows your facts.

Nothing on this site creates a lawyer–client, accountant–client or adviser relationship. Reading a guide, running a calculator or printing the decision sheet does not make this site or its reviewers your advisers.

No warranty of accuracy or currency

Company, tax, immigration and sector-licensing rules in China change, and their application differs by city, district, bank branch and issuing authority. The site dates its guides and updates them when it can, but it does not warrant that any page reflects the position on the day you read it, or the position that applies where you intend to operate.

Where a page describes a rule, the authoritative source is the rule itself — the published law, the regulation, or the written answer of the authority that decides your case. If a page and an official document disagree, the official document governs.

Calculators are models

The tools on this site apply assumptions that are stated on the page. They do not know your sector, your premises, your payroll, your tax residency, your treaty position or your bank's practice. Their output is an estimate for planning a conversation, not a quotation, an assessment or a tax computation.

Third-party links

Links to other websites — including official registries, banks and government portals — are provided for reference. This site does not control those sites and is not responsible for their content, availability or accuracy.

Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, the site and its authors, editors and reviewers accept no liability for any loss or damage arising from reliance on the material here, including decisions to incorporate, invest, contract, hire or exit. If you need certainty, obtain it from a licensed professional and from the authority that will decide your matter.

Jurisdiction

This site is an editorial project published from outside mainland China. Nothing in it is intended to constitute the provision of legal services in any jurisdiction where its authors are not qualified to provide them.
